extracted.intended_audience: investigators and research administrators preparing NIH R01 grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required formatting/contents for preparing and submitting an NIH R01 Research Project Grant application, including page limits, required documents, budget formats, and component-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOFO precedence
rubrics_metrics.description: If general/project information, required documents, and page limits are different from the Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO), the NOFO wins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the NOFO when there is any conflict between these general guidelines and the specific FOA/NOFO instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Period
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Period up to 5 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan the scope and timeline of the proposed research within a maximum five-year project period unless the FOA specifies otherwise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: general policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget generally not limited but must reflect the actual needs of the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare budgets that are realistic and justified for the work proposed; avoid requesting unnecessary funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior approval for large budget requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests greater than $500,000 in direct costs require prior approval from the program director.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact program staff and obtain required approvals before submitting applications requesting >$500,000 direct costs in any year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Budget use
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Modular Budget for requests up to $250,000 of direct costs/year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If requesting ≤ $250,000 direct costs per year, prepare a modular budget format rather than an R&R detailed budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&R Detailed Budget use
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Detailed Budget for requests greater than $250,000 of direct costs/year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For requests > $250,000 direct costs/year, complete the R&R Detailed Budget and justify all costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — personnel-only for modular
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification: Provide personnel justification only, no amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using Modular Budget, describe personnel roles and effort but do not include dollar amounts in the justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Narrative Justification for DMS costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional Narrative Justification: Justify Data Management and Sharing plan costs, if any. If no costs associated, disclose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state and justify any costs associated with the Data Management and Sharing (DMS) plan; if none, indicate that no costs are requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justify all costs in detailed budget
rubrics_metrics.description: For R&R Detailed Budget, justify all costs including Data Management and Sharing plan costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item justification for all requested costs when submitting a detailed budget, including any DMS-related expenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: SciENcv requirement for biographical sketch
rubrics_metrics.description: Required to use SciENcv Template for Biographical Sketch (as applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare Biographical Sketches using the SciENcv format when indicated by the FOA or application instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Due Dates
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard due dates for NIH R01 submissions: New Grant Applications — February 5. Renewal, Resubmission and Revision Applications — March 5, June 5, July 5, October 5, November 5. AIDS and AIDS-related Applications — May 7, September 7, January 7. LOI Due Date as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm the applicable receipt date(s) for your application type and FOA; apply any FOA-specific deadlines which may override these general dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary/Abstract length
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Summary/Abstract — 30 lines of text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a succinct summary of the project within the 30-line limit; this field is used in public reporting and reviewer orientation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Narrative length
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Narrative — 2-3 Sentences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write a brief, plain-language statement on the public health relevance of the project in 2–3 sentences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography & References Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Bibliography & References Cited — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include all cited literature without page limits; ensure citations are complete and follow required formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilities & Other Resources — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe institutional resources, core facilities, and other supports available to the project; provide sufficient detail for reviewers to assess environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment — No page restriction. List major items of equipment available for the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and briefly describe major equipment relevant to the proposed research; do not include exhaustive inventories unless requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Attachments — As applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include additional required or FOA-specified attachments in the Other Attachments section when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Biographical Sketch — 5 pages each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit each investigator’s biosketch to five pages, following the required format and content sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current & Pending Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Current & Pending Support — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete and accurate current and pending support information for senior/key personnel; include all relevant entries as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application (resubmissions/revisions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Application — 1 page maximum. For resubmission and revision applications only; Required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For resubmitted or revised applications, include a one-page introduction addressing prior review critiques and changes made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims — 1 page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present concise, clearly stated specific aims on a single page that outline the goals and expected outcomes of the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy length and required sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy — 12 pages and must include the following sections: Significance, Innovation, Approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize the Research Strategy into the required sections (Significance, Innovation, Approach) and keep the entire Research Strategy within the 12-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (renewal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress Report Publication List — No page restriction. For renewal applications only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For renewal applications, include a comprehensive publication list demonstrating productivity from the prior project period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals section
rubrics_metrics.description: Vertebrate Animals — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required vertebrate animal documentation and details as applicable to the research; follow specific FOA or PHS policy guidance where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research section
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Agent Research — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include required documentation and safety/compliance information for research involving select agents when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When proposing multiple PDs/PIs, provide a leadership plan describing roles, governance, and responsibility distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Consortium/Contractual Agreements — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe and document consortium arrangements, subcontract terms, and institutional agreements; include letters or planned budgets as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of Support — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include letters from collaborators, consultants, or institutional officials that substantiate commitments and resource availability when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Sharing Plan — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide plans for sharing data, tools, and resources generated by the project as required by NIH policy and the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Plans — No page restriction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include additional required plans (e.g., enrollment, recruitment, safety monitoring) as applicable and as specified in the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Management and Sharing (DMS) Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Management and Sharing (DMS) Plan — 1 page maximum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a one-page DMS plan following NIH DMS guidance; justify any associated costs in the budget justification or additional narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources — 1 page maximum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a one-page description of how key biological/chemical resources will be authenticated and validated.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information — As applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required human subjects, clinical trial, and protection information when the research involves human participants; follow PHS and FOA-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix — Refer to FOA guidelines for page restrictions. Only include appendix materials if the FOA requests them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not add unsolicited appendix materials; include only FOA-allowed items and respect any FOA-specific page or content restrictions.
